rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA-patevyys (LVI- ja sahkourakointi) covering the field of activity required by this framework agreement, valid until 31 March 2027.
Visakoivu Oy maintains liability insurance (toiminnan vastuuvakuutus) with cover of EUR 2,000,000, which exceeds the minimum threshold set out in clause 3.2.
Visakoivu Oy's equity ratio was 35.2% in the 2025 financial year, exceeding the required minimum.
Visakoivu Oy's revenue in the 2025 financial year was EUR 20,300,000, well above the required minimum.

Visakoivu Oy operates a tiered response-time model for corrective maintenance: urgent faults affecting safety or building operation are prioritised ahead of routine call-offs, with response commitments set out in the maintenance plan submitted alongside this tender.

Visakoivu Oy holds F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen patevyys (F-gas qualification for refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment), valid until 31 January 2028, and services kylmalaitteet at client properties under this qualification.

Subcontractors are engaged only for defined scopes outside Visakoivu Oy's own disciplines, vetted for relevant qualifications and Urakkavarmenne compliance before appointment, and supervised by a named Visakoivu Oy site lead who remains accountable for the work to the City.

On handover, Visakoivu Oy will deliver an up-to-date asset register and supporting documentation for the property stock covered by the framework agreement, in a format agreed with the City's property management unit, and will keep the register current for the duration of the agreement.

Visakoivu Oy proposes service level targets covering fault response and resolution times, planned maintenance completion rates and reporting turnaround, to be set out in full in the maintenance plan and monitored jointly with the City's property management unit.

New and altered building services installations are commissioned and tested against the relevant technical standard before handover, with results recorded and provided to the City as part of the documentation package.

Condition-monitoring data is collected and evaluated by Visakoivu Oy's rakennusautomaatio team (18 specialists), who maintain building automation and monitoring systems across client properties as part of routine and preventive maintenance.

Site personnel operate under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety system and hold the qualifications required for their trade, including LUSA-patevyys and Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1, for electrical work.

Visakoivu Oy's site personnel comply with the City's access control and site security procedures at each property, including sign-in, identification and any property-specific security briefings required by the City.
Visakoivu Oy will price the framework agreement in euro.
Where subcontractors are used, their costs will be itemised separately in the cost breakdown provided to the City, so that subcontractor pricing is transparent within the overall tender price.
Visakoivu Oy will provide a full cost breakdown by service category and property, in accordance with Section 7's pricing format.
Visakoivu Oy accepts a contractual penalty tied to shortfalls against the agreed service level, with the mechanism and rate to be finalised in the framework agreement's contract documents.
CVs of the key personnel proposed for this framework agreement, covering the relevant LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito disciplines, are enclosed with this tender.
A current kaupparekisteriote for Visakoivu Oy (business ID 1876543-2) is enclosed with this tender.

Pricing is structured on a per-property basis, consistent with the framework agreement's call-off structure; a per-square-metre reference rate is also provided on the pricing form (Liite 1) where requested.
All unit rates and monetary figures in this tender are expressed to two decimal places.
The reference currency for all framework agreement pricing is euro.
This tender will be submitted before the stated deadline of 19 October 2026, 12:00 (EET).

Energy-efficiency measures (adjusting run-time schedules, optimising ventilation and heating curves, and flagging plant nearing end-of-life for efficiency-driven renewal) are planned and reported under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system.

Unresolved faults are escalated through a defined chain from the responsible site technician to the discipline lead and, where a fault remains open beyond its target resolution time, to Visakoivu Oy's account manager for the framework agreement, who reports the escalation to the City's property management unit.

Quality control and testing on maintenance and installation work is carried out under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, including documented inspection and sign-off before work is closed out.

Visakoivu Oy already operates preventive maintenance plans under comparable public framework agreements, including a EUR 1,120,000 school-property LVI maintenance framework with Keski-Vaaran kaupunki, and will apply the same planning approach to this agreement.

Visakoivu Oy provides round-the-clock on-call duty within Finland, covering the properties in scope through its LVI, sahko and kiinteistonhoito teams, and confirms this satisfies the binding condition at Liite A, clause 3.2.
Visakoivu Oy accepts the retention percentage terms set out in Liite B; the applicable rate will be confirmed in the signed contract documents.
A description of Visakoivu Oy's quality management system, certified to NMSB 7310:2015, is enclosed with this tender.
This tender is submitted using the tender form referenced as Liite 1, completed in full.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this tender for the technical property maintenance framework agreement, reference KESKIJKAU-2026-0143. We have read the notice and both annexes in full and have addressed every requirement in the sections that follow.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services company based in Jyvaskyla, founded in 1994, with around 180 employees working across LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito. The company holds NMSB 7310, NMSB 74210 and NMSB 75310 certification, LUSA-patevyys, and Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja status, and delivers maintenance outsourcing, installation and framework-agreement work for public and private clients across Keski-Suomi.
